topic: States of Matter and Particle Behavior
key_concepts: Matter exists in three states: solid, liquid, and gas
Phase changes include melting, evaporation, condensation, freezing, sublimation, and depos
Temperature affects the arrangement and motion of particles
Heating a substance causes its particles to move more energetically
Heat is exchanged between a substance and its surroundings until equilibrium temperature i
Temperature is a measurement of the amount of heat energy present
The water cycle involves changes of water among solid, liquid, and gas forms
Evaporation and condensation are processes in the water cycle
Dehydration occurs when water loss reaches 2% of body mass or above
Heat stroke can occur when body temperature rises to 40°C or above
Air pollution can cause long-term breathing problems and death
Gaseous pollutants can spread through air and affect human health
